text: Bridge, standing at x0 z-7 facing yaw 0 (forward to helm), looking straight up: the ceiling light fixture has a thick black jagged/stair-stepped outline around the white panel; edges step in blocks rather than a clean rectangle, looks like shadow-map acne or overlapping recess geometry

Bridge, x0 z-7, facing the rear door (yaw ~187), level: the yellow light strip above the bridge door is broken into stair-stepped segments with black dashes along its lower edge (looks like z-fighting between the strip and the door header/wall), and the door frame edges show small steps/slivers at x~535 and x~880 where wall panels meet the frame

(Retake for previous note, the earlier shot faced forward by mistake) Bridge, x0 z-7, facing rear door yaw ~187: yellow strip above door stair-stepped with black dashes (z-fighting), small slivers at door frame edges.

Bridge, x-0.2 z-8.7, facing forward (yaw ~0) toward the helm/front window: the overhead status readout above the front window is cut off at its right end: the last field reads '10.0' with the rest of the text (presumably the Rs altitude unit) clipped by the panel edge. Light-grey slivers of wall show through along the top edge of the readout panel (stepped gap between panel and wall/ceiling).

Corridor, just past the bridge door (x0.4 z-2.6), facing aft down the corridor (yaw ~190): the right-hand handrail runs straight across the lab door opening at waist height (rail drawn in front of/through the door panel), so the doorway appears barred by the rail; expected the rail to stop at the door frame.

Quarters, standing by the desk (x3.3 z3.3), turned to face the bunk wall (roughly facing aft/+z), level: a large flat dark-brown rectangle hangs on the wall above the bunk with a single small yellow fleck near its left edge; no frame, no content, edges slightly ragged. Reads as a missing texture or an unlit screen with a stray light chip, unclear what it is meant to be.

Corridor, aft end near the quarters door (x-0.2 z4.5), facing the corridor side wall (yaw ~86, i.e. -634 in state), slightly up: the right-hand corridor window does not show only space. A blue-grey interior wall panel with seams and bolts fills the right half of the window, in front of the starfield. Looks like the outside of a neighbouring room (lab or engineering) poking into the window view; expected only stars and the black-hole sky.

Same corridor window, one step closer (x-0.66 z4.48, yaw ~86): the paneled blue-grey wall section is clearly floating out in space beyond the glass, at an angle, with stars visible above and below it.

Corridor outside the lab door (x0.2 z-1.2), facing aft toward quarters/engineering (yaw ~159-219): the wall and ceiling lighting shows strong concentric banding: rings of flat grey steps around each ceiling light instead of a smooth falloff, very visible on the pale corridor walls. Also seen at k_yaw86/k_yaw219/k_yaw159.

Lab, x-3.5 z-0.7, facing the archive console and lab window (yaw ~97, toward -x/outboard), level: the world-space 'E Open the archive' use prompt is drawn on top of the archive screen's list and hides entry 1 ('The Clocks'); the list also skips from '5 Hover' to '7 Evaporation'. The sky in the lab window behind the console is heavily posterized: flat brown/black contour blotches rather than a smooth gradient (beyond plain low-res blur).
